title: astragalus atropilosulus var. bequaertii
intro: Astragalus atropilosulus var. bequaertii, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the legume family Fabaceae, is a type of legume native to the Philippines. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus atropilosulus var. bequaertii include the ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiproliferative effects against certain cancer cells. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
